text: This window only tells its story where the sun falls.
At dawn, a knight was sent to slay the dragon that ate the sun.
asr: At dawn, a night was sent to slay the dragon that ate the sun.

text: He crossed the hills and rivers in the white noon light.
All afternoon they fought, and the shadows grew longer.
Then, in the red of evening, he saw what the dragon was guarding.
The last ember of the sun, kept warm until morning.
So the knight laid down his sword.
asr: So the night laid down his sword.

text: And every night since, one pane of glass keeps its own light.
